tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search the world's largest independently-tested directory of agent-payable services (x402 endpoints, MCP servers, AI APIs). Free. Returns verdict, scores, price per call, and measured latency. Use it to find the exact `service` name for get_review.

tools.name: get_review
tools.description: Full receipts-verified review of one agent-economy service: BUY/CAUTION/AVOID/INTERIM verdict (INTERIM = single verified result, pending deep review), scores, measured latency/error rate, and on-chain purchase receipts. Free.

tools.name: request_review
tools.description: Request that UseTested buy and test an agent-economy service (x402 endpoint, MCP server, AI API) we haven't reviewed yet. Free. Queues the service for evaluation consideration — requests factor into which services we test next. No SLA or guaranteed verdict.

tools.name: request_retest
tools.description: Get an upfront quote for UseTested to re-test a service we have already reviewed — e.g. its quality changed, the review is stale, or measured numbers no longer match reality. Free. Returns the exact total: $1.00 rubric fee + the service's current advertised per-call price x 10 probe calls. To procee

tools.name: accept_retest_quote
tools.description: Accept the quote from request_retest and pay the quoted total via x402 (USDC on Base) — paid automatically by your x402 MCP client. On settlement the re-test request is recorded (status paid, tx stored) and queued. Input: the exact service_name and quote_total_usd from your quote.

tools.name: get_bundle
tools.description: Every receipts-verified UseTested review in a category (inference|data|search|media|infrastructure), sorted by reliability. Costs $0.05 via x402 (USDC on Base) — paid automatically by your x402 MCP client.

tools.name: report_pulse
tools.description: For service providers: self-report your endpoint as LIVE right now. $0.005 via x402 (USDC on Base) — the settlement receipt is stored as your claim's proof. One report per service per 24h; LIVE renders as ALIVE for 24h, LIKELY ALIVE until 14 days, then UNTESTED; UseTested's own sweep results overrid
